name: Juuniji Ikoi
source:
Third year student from "Moon Academy", another side of Saint Solyluna Academy. The lone survival and successor of 零（シュラーゲン), one of three magic factors currently at war at Moon Academy.

She's in hiding to avoid 双鉗（ミリアーデ)'s pursuit. Being viewed as a genius by her peers.
